task.text: For an event or our shop, I want the machine to serve as a fun visual feature, since being “cool” and “interesting looking” can compensate for many things. When is the new shipment expected? I also still do not know the height of the base section containing the green and power button. If that base is remade, is its size fixed, or could its dimensions change? Specifically, what is the distance in inches from the bottom of the base to the top of the power-button section? Your hand appeared to be about the same size as that section when you pressed the button in the video; is that assumption correct?
